title: api.pagination_meta
description: Pagination of an index endpoint (BE-API-21..27): the `meta` block and the number of items on the page for a list of `total_count` matching records, given the raw `page` and `per_page` query values. page = integer prefix of the value read leniently (leading whitespace and a sign accepted; no digits -> 0), absent or below 1 -> 1; per_page absent -> 100; a value starting with a digit -> its leading integer (0 allowed); any other value (including a negative one) -> 25. meta: if total_count > 0, total_pages = ceil(total_count / per_page), next_page = page + 1 when page < total_pages else null, prev_page = page - 1 when page > 1 else null; if total_count = 0 every field is 0/null. per_page 0 with total_count > 0 is an unhandled failure (error server_error, HTTP 500). With `cached_count` (indexes that cache their count) the cached value replaces total_count only when cached_count > per_page x page, both taken as integer prefixes of the raw values (absent page 1, absent per_page 100, no digits 0), not the normalised ones.

total_count.description: Number of records matching the request's filters.

page.description: Raw value of the `page` query parameter (a string as sent; an integer is read as its decimal text).

per_page.description: Raw value of the `per_page` query parameter.

cached_count.x-kit-absent: nothing cached (or an index without a count cache)
cached_count.description: Count already cached under this request's count-cache key (invoices and fees indexes, BE-API-26).

items.description: Records returned on the requested page.
